verdict.line: You lose if the game drags past level 9 and Irelia's passive and item spikes take over; you win if you abuse your E range before level 6 and never let a fight run long.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) hits from 900 range, which is farther than every threat Irelia has before 6 — Bladesurge (600), Defiant Dance (825), Flawless Duet (850) — so you can tax her for free while she has no answer. That early edge is why Illaoi holds lane and solo-kill advantage here, but the 49.5% overall win rate across 1,740 games shows Irelia's Ionian Fervor stacking and mid-game item spikes claw the game back if you let trades go long instead of hitting and leaving.

theirWindow.what: At max stacks her passive grants bonus on-hit damage on top of the attack speed, which is what flips an extended melee trade in her favor. Disengage before she caps stacks rather than standing in a prolonged auto-trade.

yourWindow.what: Rip the spirit with E (Test of Spirit) at 900 range and walk away — the echoed damage punishes her for approaching without ever putting you inside Bladesurge, Defiant Dance, or Flawless Duet range.

start.why: The 52.4% win rate (21 games, 70% pick) option — the lifesteal lets you win the short E-poke trades outright instead of just chipping her.

boots.why: 82.1% pick at 43.5% win rate — flat physical damage reduction directly cuts into Bladesurge and auto-reset damage from her stacked passive.

core.why: Armor shred stacks on every W (Harsh Lesson) leap and tentacle hit, which matters against an all-physical-damage threat like Irelia.
The bonus health and damage shield let you survive a Flawless Duet stun-into-Q-reset chain instead of dying to it outright.
Converts her burst into damage-over-time, which your tentacle sustain and W leap heal can outlast.

situational.when: she is snowballing on stacked passive damage and you need the grievous wounds to cut her Bladesurge healing
the game goes long and you need more healing amplification off your W leaps and tentacle procs to outsustain her
you want the ability-haste and slow proc for earlier wave control instead of pure duel stats

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force rewards the extended E-W-Q trades you're forcing before level 6, and converts into execute damage and healing that outlasts her burst; master-tier Illaoi (234 games) instead runs Grasp of the Undying for the flat sustain and tankiness, which suits a player prioritizing wave presence over kill pressure.

summoners.why: Flash + Exhaust is the standard pick (50% win rate, 51.6% pick) — Exhaust blunts both the attack-speed spike from her stacked passive and the damage on a committed Defiant Dance. Flash + Teleport (41.7% win rate, 38.7% pick) trades that all-in safety for side-lane and split-push flexibility if you're playing for map pressure instead of a lane kill.

playing.title: Poke with E, never commit
playing.detail: Rip her spirit with E (Test of Spirit) at 900 range and back off before she can close — this is the free damage source the matchup is built on before level 6.

playing.title: Don't feed Bladesurge resets
playing.detail: Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) dashes 600 range and refreshes its cooldown if the target is Marked or dies — don't stand at low health near minions she can reset off.

playing.title: Bait, don't eat, Defiant Dance
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) deals more damage the longer she charges it and reduces her physical damage taken while charging — don't dump Q (Tentacle Smash) into a charging Defiant Dance; wait for the release.

playing.title: Respect the Flawless Duet line
playing.detail: E (Flawless Duet) sends two blades that converge, stunning and Marking anything caught between them — stand off that line so you don't eat a stun into a free Q reset.

playing.title: Use R to punish her dive
playing.detail: Once you're 6, if she closes in anyway, answer with R (Leap of Faith) — it spawns a Tentacle for every champion hit and turns her engage into your zone.

playing.title: Cut her stacks with disengage
playing.detail: Track Ionian Fervor stacks all lane; once she's near max, break the fight rather than trading autos into her bonus on-hit damage.

playing.title: Black Cleaver before extended fights
playing.detail: Get Black Cleaver's armor shred online before you commit to longer trades — it's what lets your tentacle and W sustain outpace her scaling physical damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade patterns are this brief's own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Even though Illaoi is strong in melee fights, an Irelia with 5 stacks of (P) flips the odds in her favor. Try to harass Irelia through [E] without allowing her to close in before reaching level 6, and engage with [E]-[R] if Irelia closes in after reaching level 6.
